body.name: Observational-and-denominator lock system
body.construction: For the affine family, form the observational rows \(A_{\mathrm{obs},z}:w\mapsto Z_o(0)\delta_w o_z-o_z(0)\delta_w Z_o\), the denominator row \(d:w\mapsto Z_x(0)\delta_w h-h(0)\delta_w Z_x\), and the numerator row \(b:w\mapsto Z_x(0)\delta_w k-k(0)\delta_w Z_x\). Set \(E=[A_{\mathrm{obs}};d]\), \(E_T=ER_T\), and \(b_T=bR_T\).
